terra.problem: The first moment’s title says “Ahab,” but the king was Ahaz (2 Kings 16:7–10).

The moments describe Assyria’s actions or influence, but most events do not happen in Assyria: they take place in or concern Judah, Israel, Damascus, or Jerusalem. Hoshea’s place of imprisonment is not specified. Only the third moment includes Israelites being taken to Assyria.
Words such as “vassal,” “tribute,” “envoys,” and “besieged” may be above a 5th-grade reading level. Consider simpler wording or brief explanations.
